text:
marie: Nimbus Labs on prod-eu reporting intermittent 502/504s from our hosted API (endpoint: /v1/embeddings). Started ~07:34 UTC, roughly 15% error rate for their tenant. Low QPS but bursts during their token refresh. Posting repro + logs below.

tom: can you share sample curl + response and any x-request-id headers? also which model/route?

marie: route=hostedapi-eu, model=embed-lite, tenant=nimbus-labs. Example: 
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_nimbus\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-request-id: EU-NT-0001
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 0
{ \"error\": \"upstream timeout\" }
```

dan: looking at edge envoy metrics for hostedapi-eu, seeing repeated \"upstream connect error\" and http2 stream resets around 07:34-07:40. snippet from envoy logs: 
```
[2026-02-11T07:34:12.512Z] ERROR envoy upstream: connection failure: connection refused, backend=auth-front-03
[2026-02-11T07:34:12.518Z] 504 response for request id=EU-NT-0001
[2026-02-11T07:34:13.033Z] http2 remote reset code=REFUSED_STREAM for stream id=12345
```

marie: Nimbus did a key rotation at 07:28 UTC per their support note and we see a spike in auth token exchanges for their tenant 07:29-07:31. Could be correlated.

dan: infra note: we rolled nginx-ingress v2.3.0 yesterday morning with a default keepalive_timeout change from 75s -> 5s for upstreams (intended for ephemeral workloads). That could cause frequent connection close -> reuse failures, especially with token refresh bursts.

tom: hunch: Nginx keepalive reduction combined with a sudden auth burst causes upstream connection churn; envoy/edge sees connection resets and surface 5xx to clients. Any recent change to connection pool sizes or upstream health checks?

dan: also noticed a slight bump in server-side accept queue length on model-cache nodes at same time (small numbers) and occasional \"too many open files\" logs in auth-front-03 (fd limits creeping up).

ops_lead: mitigation options:
- revert nginx-ingress to v2.2.x to restore previous keepalive behavior (fastest).
- temporarily increase nginx worker_connections and keepalive_pool on ingress for hostedapi-eu.
- pin Nimbus to a standby model pool that uses separate auth-front instances.

marie: I can run a scoped reproduce against Nimbus tenant (low qps) with a loop to validate: 
```
for i in {1..40}; do curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_nimbus\" -d '{\"input\":\"ping\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings >/dev/null & done; wait
```
I'll watch for 502/504 and check envoy logs for resets.

infra-bot: alert: hostedapi-eu 5xx_rate tenant=nimbus-labs >= 10% over 3m. Incident INC-5879 created. Paging oncall.

[~60s later]

marie: repro loop produced 6/40 504s within the first 90s. Envoy logs show: \"connection reset by peer\" and nginx logs show upstream_closed prematurely. x-request-ids: EU-NT-0001, EU-NT-0004, EU-NT-0007.

ops_lead: proceed with rollback to nginx-ingress v2.2.8 in eu cluster. Also increase keepalive_pool to 256 for hostedapi-eu ingress. Rolling now; ETA ~2m to reconcile.

[~3m later]

dan: rollback completed at 07:39 UTC. Post-rollback checks: upstream resets dropped ~90%, 5xx rate for tenant now ~0.8% (was ~15%). fd usage on auth-front-03 returned to nominal.

marie: notified Nimbus support contact; they report significant reduction in errors. Closing immediate escalation. Creating SUP ticket SUP-90234 and opening RCA to follow.

tom: RCA action items:
- add canary gating for ingress changes that touch keepalive/idle timeouts (especially for customers with frequent token refresh patterns).
- add metric: ingress_upstream_keepalive_drop_total and expose per-tenant label when possible.
- run pre-deploy test that simulates bursty token rotations + sustained small qps to validate connection reuse.
- review fd ulimit on auth-front pool and ensure autoscaling triggers earlier.

ops_lead: thanks team. Marking SUP-90234 resolved after RCA created. Will push checklist change to deploy playbook. :white_check_mark:
